title: Plant and Animal Parts
seo_title: Grade 1 Plant and Animal Parts Worksheets: How Parts Help, and Copying Nature
standard_text: Use materials to design a solution to a human problem by mimicking how plants and/or animals use their external parts to help them survive, grow, and meet their needs.
meta_desc: Free grade 1 science worksheets on plant and animal parts (NGSS 1-LS1-1): roots, leaves, shells, fur and fins, and inventions that copy nature. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: People copy plant and animal parts to solve problems.
body_html:
How to think about it

Body parts help plants and animals live.

  • Parts help them eat, move, stay safe and stay warm.
  • People copy these parts to solve problems.
  • Helmet = turtle shell. Flippers = duck feet.
Example

What do a duck's webbed feet help it do?

Look at the feet.

Answer: swim

Example

A helmet copies which animal part?

It protects.

Answer: a turtle's hard shell

Common mistakes

  • Thinking roots make food. Leaves make food.
  • Mixing up the job of a part, like a shell for swimming.
  • Thinking inventions never copy nature.

faq.a: Roots take in water, stems hold the plant up, leaves make food and thorns or spines protect it.
Shells and spines protect, fur keeps them warm, wings help them fly and fins or webbed feet help them swim.
Helmets copy hard shells, swim flippers copy duck feet and hook-and-loop tape copies burrs.
